files.title: Image URLs
files.description: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF or SVG links. In one-PDF mode the pages follow this order.

mode.title: Output
mode.description: Combine every image into one PDF (scans, receipts, photo albums), or make one PDF per image.

outputName.title: PDF file name
outputName.description: Name of the combined PDF (one-PDF mode). Also used as the PDF title.

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Paper size, or a page exactly the size of each image.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: Auto turns the page sideways for landscape images.

fit.title: Image placement
fit.description: Contain shows the whole image; cover fills the page and crops the edges.

maxImagePx.title: Max image size (px)
maxImagePx.description: Longest side of each image in the PDF. 2480 px = A4 at 300 dpi; lower makes smaller files.

quality.title: JPEG quality
quality.description: 30–100. 85 looks like the original at a fraction of the size.

grayscale.title: Black and white
grayscale.description: Good for document scans: smaller files, cleaner print.

keepTransparency.title: Keep transparency
keepTransparency.description: PNG with transparency stays PNG (bigger). Off = flattened onto white.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
